rulings.why: Real persistent +5 fly Speed with no working lane: `speeds` takes Math.max (sets, never adds) and landSpeedBonus is land-only; the one additive idiom that exists (timewracked-dedication's "min(@actor.speed.fly,5)+@actor.speed.fly") is order-dependent and build.ts:2375 sorts Character.feats by level, so on a level-2 feat it would resolve against fly=0 and be a guaranteed no-op — every fly-granting feat in core is level 5+. needsEngineWork stands.

Fix is wrong twice over: `grantedFeatId` is a BACKGROUND field (types.ts:625, read only as bg?.grantedFeatId in build.ts) and no feat carries it, so usedIn() rejects it; and the only core.feats['shake-it-off'] is the BARBARIAN rage feat from Player Core 2, not the once/day fortune reaction from Pathfinder #194 the archetype actually grants — that one exists as core.actions['shake-it-off'], which the record already points at via its descRef, and no action-grant lane exists.

"Two sea mines a day" is a player-side trackable pool and each activation off-loads one mine, so uses of the activity = 2/day; limitedUses {max,per:'day'} is the established shape (332 feats already carry it) and the record carries no uses field.
